name: The Walk Through a Breath
prompt: Stretch a branching system of rose silk air sacs over springy whalebone hoops. Visitors walk an open path between the chambers as attendants pump the sacs with foot bellows. One collapsed lobe reveals its delicate skeleton.

name: A Skeleton for Rain
prompt: Spread the giant ceramic skeleton of an imaginary cloud animal across a gravel court. Rainwater gathers inside its hollow ribs and pours out through its toes. Children slide small measuring cups beneath the different streams.

name: The Cabinet of Hands
prompt: Set out a row of monumental articulated plaster hands, each holding a miniature room where a particular hand movement is taught. One hand sews, one signs, one cups water. Students copy the poses from red footstools below.

name: Pulse Market
prompt: Trace an immense branching network of crimson and blue glass tubes on a white tiled floor. Visitors pump rubber bulbs to send coloured beads along different paths. One low bridge marks the point where the two currents exchange their loads.

name: Lessons in Balance
prompt: Raise a single oversized ivory ear on a timber cradle. The cut-open inner chambers house three transparent curved tracks. A visitor walking a blue counterweight along one changes the tilt of a little wooden house at its base.
